sentences.sentence: Seine Karriere begann völlig unerwartet mit einem Turniersieg.
sentences.sentence_translation: His career began completely unexpectedly with a tournament victory.

sentences.sentence: Der Meister blickte auf eine erfolgreiche Karriere zurück.
sentences.sentence_translation: The master looked back on a successful career.

sentences.sentence: Seine erste große Tat war der Sieg gegen den Grossmeister.
sentences.sentence_translation: His first great deed was the victory against the grandmaster.

sentences.sentence: In der Tat überraschte der junge Spieler alle Experten.
sentences.sentence_translation: Indeed, the young player surprised all the experts.

note: Often used in the phrase 'in der Tat' meaning 'indeed'

sentences.sentence: Niemand konnte sich an seine frühen Schachpartien erinnern.
sentences.sentence_translation: Nobody could remember his early chess games.

sentences.sentence: Der Pfarrer erinnerte ihn täglich an seine Aufgaben.
sentences.sentence_translation: The priest reminded him daily of his duties.

sentences.sentence: Der junge Champion verblüffte die erfahrenen Meister.
sentences.sentence_translation: The young champion amazed the experienced masters.

sentences.sentence: Als Junge zeigte er bereits außergewöhnliche Fähigkeiten.
sentences.sentence_translation: As a boy, he already showed extraordinary abilities.

note: Can be used as noun 'der Junge' meaning 'the boy'

sentences.sentence: Der neue Weltmeister stammte aus einfachen Verhältnissen.
sentences.sentence_translation: The new world champion came from humble circumstances.

sentences.sentence: Alle träumten davon, einmal Weltmeister zu werden.
sentences.sentence_translation: Everyone dreamt of becoming world champion one day.

sentences.sentence: Sogar berühmte Meister respektierten sein außergewöhnliches Talent.
sentences.sentence_translation: Even famous masters respected his extraordinary talent.

sentences.sentence: Er konnte sogar komplizierte Stellungen mühelos analysieren.
sentences.sentence_translation: He could even analyse complicated positions effortlessly.

sentences.sentence: Jede Einzelheit seiner Partien wurde von Experten studiert.
sentences.sentence_translation: Every detail of his games was studied by experts.

sentences.sentence: In den Einzelheiten zeigte sich sein wahres Genie.
sentences.sentence_translation: His true genius showed itself in the details.

sentences.sentence: Der Zusammenhang zwischen Talent und Erfolg war offensichtlich.
sentences.sentence_translation: The connection between talent and success was obvious.

sentences.sentence: Seine Züge standen in keinem logischen Zusammenhang.
sentences.sentence_translation: His moves had no logical connection.

sentences.sentence: Sein raketenhafter Aufstieg überraschte die Schachwelt.
sentences.sentence_translation: His meteoric rise surprised the chess world.

sentences.sentence: Die Karriere entwickelte sich raketenhaft schnell.
sentences.sentence_translation: The career developed with meteoric speed.

note: Figurative use describing very rapid progress

sentences.sentence: Der aufmerksame Pfarrer bemerkte sein ungewöhnliches Talent.
sentences.sentence_translation: The attentive priest noticed his unusual talent.

sentences.sentence: Er verfolgte aufmerksam jede Bewegung seines Gegners.
sentences.sentence_translation: He attentively followed every movement of his opponent.

sentences.sentence: Der Zeitungsleser verfolgte aufmerksam die Schachberichte aus aller Welt.
sentences.sentence_translation: The newspaper reader followed the chess reports from around the world attentively.

sentences.sentence: Viele Zeitungsleser kannten bereits den Namen des jungen Meisters.
sentences.sentence_translation: Many newspaper readers already knew the name of the young master.

sentences.sentence: Eine ganze Reihe berühmter Schachmeister hatte er bereits besiegt.
sentences.sentence_translation: He had already defeated a whole series of famous chess masters.

sentences.sentence: In den vorderen Reihen saßen die erfahrensten Spieler.
sentences.sentence_translation: The most experienced players sat in the front rows.

sentences.sentence: Über seine bescheidenen Anfänge kursierten viele merkwürdige Anekdoten.
sentences.sentence_translation: Many strange anecdotes circulated about his modest beginnings.

sentences.sentence: Der Priester erzählte gern diese Anekdote über seinen ehemaligen Schützling.
sentences.sentence_translation: The priest liked to tell this anecdote about his former protégé.

sentences.sentence: Seine Kenntnisse der Eröffnungstheorie musste er noch ergänzen.
sentences.sentence_translation: He still had to supplement his knowledge of opening theory.

sentences.sentence: Der Autor ergänzte seine Erzählung um weitere interessante Details.
sentences.sentence_translation: The author added further interesting details to his story.

sentences.sentence: Mit etwa zwölf Jahren verlor er seinen Vater.
sentences.sentence_translation: At about twelve years old, he lost his father.

sentences.sentence: Das Turnier dauerte etwa drei Wochen lang.
sentences.sentence_translation: The tournament lasted for about three weeks.

sentences.sentence: In diesem Jahr gewann er seinen ersten großen Titel.
sentences.sentence_translation: This year he won his first major title.

sentences.sentence: Die Jahre seiner Kindheit waren von großer Armut geprägt.
sentences.sentence_translation: The years of his childhood were marked by great poverty.

sentences.sentence: Der überraschende Schlag des jungen Meisters verblüfte alle Experten.
sentences.sentence_translation: The surprising move of the young master astonished all experts.

sentences.sentence: Mit einem einzigen brillanten Schlag entschied er die Partie.
sentences.sentence_translation: With a single brilliant move he decided the game.

sentences.sentence: Seine bewährte Spielweise brachte ihm viele Siege ein.
sentences.sentence_translation: His proven playing style brought him many victories.

sentences.sentence: Die alten, bewährten Methoden versagten gegen den Newcomer.
sentences.sentence_translation: The old, tried and tested methods failed against the newcomer.

sentences.sentence: Selbst erfahrene Altmeister konnten seine Züge nicht verstehen.
sentences.sentence_translation: Even experienced old masters could not understand his moves.

sentences.sentence: Der ehrwürdige Altmeister musste sich dem jungen Talent geschlagen geben.
sentences.sentence_translation: The venerable old master had to admit defeat to the young talent.

sentences.sentence: Seine außergewöhnliche Begabung für die Schachkunst war unbestritten.
sentences.sentence_translation: His extraordinary talent for the art of chess was undisputed.

sentences.sentence: Trotz seiner Bildung verstand er nur wenig von der Schachkunst.
sentences.sentence_translation: Despite his education, he understood little of the art of chess.

sentences.sentence: Der Trainer stellte den jungen Schachspieler vor eine schwierige Aufgabe.
sentences.sentence_translation: The trainer set the young chess player a difficult task.

sentences.sentence: Man wird ihn bald zu den grossen Meistern stellen müssen.
sentences.sentence_translation: One will soon have to place him amongst the great masters.

sentences.sentence: Sein plötzliches Auftreten überraschte die Schachwelt völlig.
sentences.sentence_translation: His sudden emergence completely surprised the chess world.

sentences.sentence: Das bescheidene Auftreten des Champions täuschte über sein Talent hinweg.
sentences.sentence_translation: The champion's modest appearance was deceptive about his talent.

sentences.sentence: Der siebenjährige Junge zeigte bereits aussergewöhnliche Begabung.
sentences.sentence_translation: The seven-year-old boy already showed extraordinary talent.

sentences.sentence: Nach siebenjähriger Ausbildung war er endlich bereit für Turniere.
sentences.sentence_translation: After seven years of training he was finally ready for tournaments.

sentences.sentence: Das Wunderkind gewann sein erstes Turnier mit zwölf Jahren.
sentences.sentence_translation: The child prodigy won his first tournament at twelve years old.

sentences.sentence: Alle sprachen über das neue Wunderkind aus dem Dorf.
sentences.sentence_translation: Everyone was talking about the new child prodigy from the village.

sentences.sentence: Das internationale Schachturnier dauerte drei Wochen.
sentences.sentence_translation: The international chess tournament lasted three weeks.

sentences.sentence: Er siegte in jedem Schachturnier, an dem er teilnahm.
sentences.sentence_translation: He won every chess tournament he participated in.

sentences.sentence: Seine Niederlage kam für alle völlig unerwartet.
sentences.sentence_translation: His defeat came completely unexpectedly for everyone.

sentences.sentence: Der junge Meister war völlig unbekannt gewesen.
sentences.sentence_translation: The young master had been completely unknown.

sentences.sentence: Der Unbekannte besiegte alle erfahrenen Spieler mühelos.
sentences.sentence_translation: The unknown person defeated all experienced players effortlessly.

sentences.sentence: Niemand hatte von diesem Unbekannten je gehört.
sentences.sentence_translation: No one had ever heard of this unknown person.

sentences.sentence: Seine ruhmreiche Laufbahn begann mit einem überraschenden Sieg.
sentences.sentence_translation: His glorious career began with a surprising victory.

sentences.sentence: Der Champion blickte auf ruhmreiche Jahrzehnte zurück.
sentences.sentence_translation: The champion looked back on glorious decades.

sentences.sentence: Die alte Gilde der Schachmeister nahm ihn widerwillig auf.
sentences.sentence_translation: The old guild of chess masters reluctantly accepted him.

sentences.sentence: Er gehörte nun zur ehrwürdigen Gilde der Grossmeister.
sentences.sentence_translation: He now belonged to the venerable guild of grandmasters.

sentences.sentence: Sein Talent war derart aussergewöhnlich, dass alle staunten.
sentences.sentence_translation: His talent was extraordinary to such an extent that everyone was amazed.

sentences.sentence: Die Überraschung war derart gross, dass niemand sprach.
sentences.sentence_translation: The surprise was great to such an extent that no one spoke.

sentences.sentence: Der junge Meister war für seine allgemeine Bildung nicht bekannt.
sentences.sentence_translation: The young master was not known for his general education.

sentences.sentence: Im Allgemeinen zeigten sich seine Schwächen außerhalb des Schachs.
sentences.sentence_translation: In general, his weaknesses showed outside of chess.

sentences.sentence: Sein plötzlicher Aufstieg erregte großes Aufsehen in Schachkreisen.
sentences.sentence_translation: His sudden rise aroused great attention in chess circles.

sentences.sentence: Die Nachricht wird sicherlich Neugier bei den Journalisten erregen.
sentences.sentence_translation: The news will certainly arouse curiosity amongst the journalists.

sentences.sentence: Seine intellektuellen Fähigkeiten beschränkten sich auf das Schachspiel.
sentences.sentence_translation: His intellectual abilities were limited to the game of chess.

sentences.sentence: Der Pfarrer zweifelte an den intellektuellen Fortschritten des Jungen.
sentences.sentence_translation: The priest doubted the boy's intellectual progress.

sentences.sentence: Diese besondere Eigenschaft machte ihn zu einem rätselhaften Champion.
sentences.sentence_translation: This particular characteristic made him an enigmatic champion.

sentences.sentence: Der Meister besaß die Eigenschaften eines wahren Genies.
sentences.sentence_translation: The master possessed the characteristics of a true genius.

sentences.sentence: Der stumme Junge schien für das Lernen ungeeignet.
sentences.sentence_translation: The silent boy seemed unsuited for learning.

sentences.sentence: Seine Erfolge scheinen allen Erwartungen zu widersprechen.
sentences.sentence_translation: His successes seem to contradict all expectations.

sentences.sentence: Der Weltmeister war keineswegs ein begabter Schüler gewesen.
sentences.sentence_translation: The world champion had by no means been a gifted pupil.

sentences.sentence: Seine Sprachkenntnisse waren keineswegs beeindruckend für einen Weltreisenden.
sentences.sentence_translation: His language skills were by no means impressive for a world traveller.

sentences.sentence: Am Schachbrett zeigte er eine blendende Spieltechnik.
sentences.sentence_translation: At the chessboard he showed brilliant playing technique.

sentences.sentence: Der junge Champion spielte blendend gegen erfahrene Großmeister.
sentences.sentence_translation: The young champion played brilliantly against experienced grandmasters.

sentences.sentence: Von vornherein schien der Knabe für Bücher ungeeignet.
sentences.sentence_translation: From the outset the lad seemed unsuited for books.

sentences.sentence: Man hatte von vornherein wenig Hoffnung in seine Bildung gesetzt.
sentences.sentence_translation: One had placed little hope in his education from the outset.

note: Usually used in the phrase 'von vornherein'

sentences.sentence: Niemand konnte seinen Erfolg im Schach weissagen.
sentences.sentence_translation: Nobody could prophesy his success in chess.

sentences.sentence: Der alte Pfarrer hatte diese Wendung nicht weissagen können.
sentences.sentence_translation: The old priest had not been able to prophesy this turn of events.

sentences.sentence: Die Nachricht von seinem Triumph sickerte langsam durch Europa.
sentences.sentence_translation: News of his triumph slowly seeped through Europe.

sentences.sentence: Gerüchte über den jungen Champion sickern durch die Schachwelt.
sentences.sentence_translation: Rumours about the young champion seep through the chess world.

sentences.sentence: Das Geheimnis seines Erfolgs blieb allen Schachexperten verborgen.
sentences.sentence_translation: The secret of his success remained hidden from all chess experts.

sentences.sentence: Er hütete die Geheimnisse seiner Spielvorbereitung sehr sorgfältig.
sentences.sentence_translation: He guarded the secrets of his game preparation very carefully.

sentences.sentence: Der junge Schachmeister überraschte die internationale Fachwelt.
sentences.sentence_translation: The young chess master surprised the international expert community.

sentences.sentence: Viele Schachmeister konnten seine Spielweise nicht verstehen.
sentences.sentence_translation: Many chess masters could not understand his style of play.

sentences.sentence: Sein Privatleben interessierte die Journalisten mehr als seine Siege.
sentences.sentence_translation: His private life interested the journalists more than his victories.

sentences.sentence: Details über das Privatleben des Meisters blieben unbekannt.
sentences.sentence_translation: Details about the master's private life remained unknown.

sentences.sentence: Er war außerstande, seine Gedanken klar auszudrücken.
sentences.sentence_translation: He was unable to express his thoughts clearly.

sentences.sentence: Der Champion schien außerstande, einfache Fragen zu beantworten.
sentences.sentence_translation: The champion seemed unable to answer simple questions.

sentences.sentence: Seine Muttersprache beherrschte er nur unvollkommen.
sentences.sentence_translation: He mastered his mother tongue only imperfectly.

sentences.sentence: In fremden Sprachen konnte er sich kaum verständigen.
sentences.sentence_translation: He could hardly communicate in foreign languages.

sentences.sentence: Jeder Satz enthielt mehrere grammatische Fehler.
sentences.sentence_translation: Every sentence contained several grammatical errors.

sentences.sentence: Er konnte keine fehlerfreien Sätze formulieren.
sentences.sentence_translation: He could not formulate error-free sentences.

sentences.sentence: Seine orthographischen Kenntnisse waren äußerst mangelhaft.
sentences.sentence_translation: His orthographic knowledge was extremely deficient.

sentences.sentence: Der Brief war orthographisch völlig fehlerhaft geschrieben.
sentences.sentence_translation: The letter was written with complete orthographic errors.

sentences.sentence: Seine Briefe wimmelten von peinlichen Fehlern.
sentences.sentence_translation: His letters were teeming with embarrassing mistakes.

sentences.sentence: Der offensichtliche Fehler entging niemandem.
sentences.sentence_translation: The obvious mistake escaped no one's notice.

sentences.sentence: Die Journalisten waren verärgert über seine kurzen Antworten.
sentences.sentence_translation: The journalists were annoyed by his brief answers.

sentences.sentence: Sein unhöfliches Verhalten verärgerte die anderen Spieler.
sentences.sentence_translation: His rude behaviour annoyed the other players.

sentences.sentence: Seine Kollegen respektierten nur sein Schachtalent.
sentences.sentence_translation: His colleagues respected only his chess talent.

sentences.sentence: Der erfahrene Kollege gab ihm wertvolle Ratschläge.
sentences.sentence_translation: The experienced colleague gave him valuable advice.

sentences.sentence: Der Meister blickte ingrimmig auf das verlorene Spiel.
sentences.sentence_translation: The master looked furiously at the lost game.

sentences.sentence: Sie schüttelte ingrimmig den Kopf über seine Dummheit.
sentences.sentence_translation: She shook her head furiously at his stupidity.

note: literary register, expressing intense bitter anger

sentences.sentence: Die anderen Spieler spotten über seine einfache Herkunft.
sentences.sentence_translation: The other players mock his humble origins.

sentences.sentence: Er hatte schon als Kind über die Gelehrten gespottet.
sentences.sentence_translation: Even as a child he had scoffed at scholars.

sentences.sentence: Seine Unbildung war in allen Gesprächen deutlich spürbar.
sentences.sentence_translation: His lack of education was clearly noticeable in all conversations.

sentences.sentence: Trotz ihrer Unbildung zeigte sie erstaunliche Intuition.
sentences.sentence_translation: Despite her ignorance, she showed remarkable intuition.

sentences.sentence: Auf diesem Gebiet war er ein absoluter Meister.
sentences.sentence_translation: In this field he was an absolute master.

sentences.sentence: Die Gebiete der Mathematik blieben ihm völlig fremd.
sentences.sentence_translation: The areas of mathematics remained completely foreign to him.

sentences.sentence: Seine Begabung war nicht universell, sondern sehr spezifisch.
sentences.sentence_translation: His talent was not universal, but very specific.

sentences.sentence: Der Professor dachte universell über alle Wissenschaften nach.
sentences.sentence_translation: The professor thought comprehensively about all sciences.

sentences.sentence: Der Sohn des armen Schiffers wurde weltberühmt.
sentences.sentence_translation: The son of the poor boatman became world-famous.

sentences.sentence: Als kleiner Sohn hatte er keine Bildung erhalten.
sentences.sentence_translation: As a small son he had received no education.

sentences.sentence: Die bluturme Familie lebte in ärmlichsten Verhältnissen.
sentences.sentence_translation: The destitute family lived in the most wretched conditions.

sentences.sentence: Er stammte aus blutarmen Verhältnissen am Fluss.
sentences.sentence_translation: He came from extremely poor circumstances by the river.

sentences.sentence: Er sprach einen südslawischen Dialekt aus seiner Heimat.
sentences.sentence_translation: He spoke a South Slavic dialect from his homeland.

sentences.sentence: Die südslawische Herkunft prägte seine frühe Kindheit.
sentences.sentence_translation: His South Slavic origins shaped his early childhood.

sentences.sentence: Der alte Donauschiffer kannte jeden Flussabschnitt genau.
sentences.sentence_translation: The old Danube boatman knew every section of the river precisely.

sentences.sentence: Als Donauschiffer verdiente sein Vater nur wenig Geld.
sentences.sentence_translation: As a Danube boatman his father earned very little money.

sentences.sentence: Das winzige Dorf lag versteckt am Flussufer.
sentences.sentence_translation: The tiny village lay hidden on the riverbank.

sentences.sentence: Seine Handschrift war winzig und kaum lesbar.
sentences.sentence_translation: His handwriting was minute and barely readable.

sentences.sentence: Die alte Barke trieb langsam den Fluss hinunter.
sentences.sentence_translation: The old barge drifted slowly down the river.

sentences.sentence: Der Fischer reparierte seine beschädigte Barke am Ufer.
sentences.sentence_translation: The fisherman repaired his damaged barge on the shore.

sentences.sentence: Der schwer beladene Getreidedampfer verließ den Hafen bei Sonnenaufgang.
sentences.sentence_translation: The heavily loaded grain steamer left the harbour at sunrise.

sentences.sentence: Auf dem Getreidedampfer arbeiteten viele arme Männer aus der Region.
sentences.sentence_translation: Many poor men from the region worked on the grain steamer.

sentences.sentence: Die Ereignisse überrannten den jungen Mann völlig unerwartet.
sentences.sentence_translation: The events overwhelmed the young man completely unexpectedly.

sentences.sentence: Der Erfolg wird ihn bald überrennen und alles verändern.
sentences.sentence_translation: Success will soon overwhelm him and change everything.

sentences.sentence: Damals war das Leben auf dem Dorf noch sehr einfach.
sentences.sentence_translation: At that time, life in the village was still very simple.

sentences.sentence: Er erinnerte sich oft an die schweren Jahre damals.
sentences.sentence_translation: He often remembered the difficult years back then.

disambiguation: boy or male person aged twelve

sentences.sentence: Der begabte Zwölfjährige gewann sein erstes Schachturnier überraschend.
sentences.sentence_translation: The gifted twelve-year-old surprisingly won his first chess tournament.

sentences.sentence: Niemand traute dem stillen Zwölfjährigen solche Fähigkeiten zu.
sentences.sentence_translation: Nobody attributed such abilities to the quiet twelve-year-old.

note: Adjectival noun; can refer to any twelve-year-old male

sentences.sentence: Der plötzliche Tod des Vaters veränderte alles für den Jungen.
sentences.sentence_translation: The sudden death of the father changed everything for the boy.

sentences.sentence: Nach dem Tod seiner Eltern lebte er bei Verwandten.
sentences.sentence_translation: After the death of his parents, he lived with relatives.

sentences.sentence: Der gütige Pfarrer nahm den Waisenjungen bei sich auf.
sentences.sentence_translation: The kind priest took in the orphaned boy.

sentences.sentence: Beim örtlichen Pfarrer lernte er die ersten Grundlagen des Lesens.
sentences.sentence_translation: With the local priest, he learnt the first basics of reading.

sentences.sentence: Das abgelegene Dorf war nur schwer zu erreichen.
sentences.sentence_translation: The remote village was difficult to reach.

sentences.sentence: Er wuchs völlig abgelegen von der modernen Welt auf.
sentences.sentence_translation: He grew up completely secluded from the modern world.

sentences.sentence: Der kleine Ort hatte nur wenige hundert Einwohner damals.
sentences.sentence_translation: The small place had only a few hundred inhabitants back then.

sentences.sentence: An diesem friedlichen Ort verbrachte er seine Kindheit.
sentences.sentence_translation: He spent his childhood in this peaceful place.

sentences.sentence: Aus Mitleid nahm der alte Mann den Waisen auf.
sentences.sentence_translation: Out of pity, the old man took in the orphan.

sentences.sentence: Das Mitleid der Dorfbewohner half dem jungen Mann sehr.
sentences.sentence_translation: The compassion of the villagers helped the young man greatly.

translation: to take in, to receive, to admit

sentences.sentence: Der Priester nahm den Waisenjungen in sein Haus auf.
sentences.sentence_translation: The priest took the orphaned boy into his house.

sentences.sentence: Die Schule wird ihn trotz seiner schwachen Noten aufnehmen.
sentences.sentence_translation: The school will admit him despite his weak grades.

sentences.sentence: Der Pater unterrichtete die Dorfkinder in Latein und Mathematik.
sentences.sentence_translation: The father taught the village children Latin and mathematics.

sentences.sentence: Mit großer Geduld erklärte ihm der alte Pater die Grundlagen.
sentences.sentence_translation: With great patience, the old father explained the basics to him.

sentences.sentence: Er gab sich redlich Mühe, dem Knaben etwas beizubringen.
sentences.sentence_translation: He made an honest effort to teach the lad something.

sentences.sentence: Seine redlichen Absichten wurden leider nicht belohnt.
sentences.sentence_translation: His sincere intentions were unfortunately not rewarded.

sentences.sentence: Der häusliche Unterricht war für ihn eine Qual.
sentences.sentence_translation: The domestic lessons were torture for him.

sentences.sentence: Sie führte ein ruhiges, häusliches Leben im Dorf.
sentences.sentence_translation: She led a quiet, domestic life in the village.

sentences.sentence: Der schwache Schüler brauchte dringend Nachhilfe in Mathematik.
sentences.sentence_translation: The weak student urgently needed tutoring in mathematics.

sentences.sentence: Trotz privater Nachhilfe verbesserten sich seine Leistungen nicht.
sentences.sentence_translation: Despite private tutoring, his performance did not improve.

translation: to make up for, to compensate

sentences.sentence: Er hoffte, seine schlechten Noten durch Fleiß wettzumachen.
sentences.sentence_translation: He hoped to make up for his poor grades through diligence.

sentences.sentence: Keine Anstrengung konnte seine natürliche Begabungslosigkeit wettmachen.
sentences.sentence_translation: No effort could compensate for his natural lack of talent.

sentences.sentence: Der maulfaule Junge antwortete nur mit Nicken oder Kopfschütteln.
sentences.sentence_translation: The taciturn boy only answered with nods or head shakes.

sentences.sentence: Seine maulfaule Art machte den Unterricht sehr schwierig.
sentences.sentence_translation: His tight-lipped manner made teaching very difficult.

sentences.sentence: Sein dumpfer Blick verriet keine Regung des Verstandes.
sentences.sentence_translation: His dull gaze betrayed no stirring of understanding.

sentences.sentence: Die Kinder starrten ihn mit dumpfem Unverständnis an.
sentences.sentence_translation: The children stared at him with dim incomprehension.

sentences.sentence: Der breitstirnige Knabe wirkte älter als seine Jahre.
sentences.sentence_translation: The broad-browed lad seemed older than his years.

sentences.sentence: Sein breitstirniges Gesicht zeigte keinerlei Ausdruck von Intelligenz.
sentences.sentence_translation: His wide-foreheaded face showed no expression of intelligence.

sentences.sentence: Der Pfarrer brachte den Jungen zur Dorfschule.
sentences.sentence_translation: The priest brought the boy to the village school.

sentences.sentence: In der kleinen Dorfschule lernte er nur langsam lesen.
sentences.sentence_translation: In the small village school he learned to read only slowly.

translation: to be able to, to manage

sentences.sentence: Der begabte Spieler vermochte komplexe Züge zu durchschauen.
sentences.sentence_translation: The gifted player was able to see through complex moves.

sentences.sentence: Niemand wird seine außergewöhnliche Leistung zu erklären vermögen.
sentences.sentence_translation: No one will be able to explain his extraordinary achievement.

note: Formal register, often used with zu + infinitive
